edge_cases_audited.name: line-clamp Firefox compatibility (task spec claims Firefox needs -moz-line-clamp)
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Task spec claims 'Firefox needs -moz-line-clamp'. Reality: `-moz-line-clamp` does not exist as a CSS property. Firefox 68+ (July 2019) implemented `-webkit-line-clamp` under the WebKit alias for cross-browser compat (MDN compat data + Bugzilla #1232992). All shipping Firefox versions render the 11 grep hits correctly: resources/css/pos-v5.css:477, resources/css/foundations/pos-v5-tokens.css:245, KioskUpsellComponent.vue:414, KioskCategoriesComponent.vue:1035/1094/1227, ItemComponent.vue:1599, StockRuptureDashboardComponent.vue:642, KdsOrderLine.vue:164/202. The standard CSS `line-clamp` shorthand (no prefix) exists in CSS Overflow Module L3 but Browser Support is partial — Chrome 113+, Safari 17.4+, Firefox 124+. RECOMMENDATION (P3/INFO): add `line-clamp: 2;` alongside `-webkit-line-clamp: 2;` for future-proofing when CSS Overflow L3 ships universally; current code works everywhere shipping today.

edge_cases_audited.name: position: sticky Safari -webkit- prefix
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Task spec says 'Safari needs -webkit-prefix' for `position: sticky`. Reality: Safari dropped the `-webkit-sticky` requirement in version 13 (Sept 2019). All current Safari + iOS Safari accept unprefixed `position: sticky`. The 8 grep hits — app.css:541, pos-v5.css:557, PosComponent.vue:4806, ItemComponent.vue:1690, ComposerVersionConflictBanner.vue:44, KdsOrderCard.vue:662, KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:2485 — all render correctly on Safari 13+. Modern caniuse: 99.7% global support unprefixed.

edge_cases_audited.name: iOS 100vh problem (URL bar consumes viewport) — 15 kiosk components use 100vh, ZERO use dvh/svh/lvh
edge_cases_audited.verdict: FUTURE-FACING ONLY — not a V1 ship blocker (Electron full-screen has no URL bar)
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Grep `100vh|height: 100vh` in resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/ returns 15 occurrences: KioskIdleScreenComponent.vue:323, KioskCartComponent.vue:704, KioskWizardComponent.vue:2391, KioskWaitingComponent.vue:529, KioskLoginComponent.vue:149 (min-height), KioskPaymentComponent.vue:903, KioskUpsellComponent.vue:290, KioskCashInstructionComponent.vue:143 (min-height), KioskConfirmationComponent.vue:455 (min-height), KioskCategoriesComponent.vue:770, KioskErrorLayoutComponent.vue:71 (min-height), KioskAppComponent.vue:1263, KioskLoyaltyComponent.vue:648 (min-height), ds/KsModal.vue:217+231. Grep `100dvh|100svh|100lvh` in same scope returns ZERO. CSS dynamic-viewport units (dvh = dynamic, svh = small, lvh = large) shipped Safari 15.4 (Mar 2022) + Chrome 108 + Firefox 101. If kiosk EVER deployed to iPad Safari mobile tab (not Electron, not Guided Access PWA-standalone, not WebView), the URL bar collapse/expand would cause 50-100px content cropping or scroll-jank. RECONCILIATION: per `docs/PROJECT_CONTINUITY_AND_VISION.md:51` + `docs/DESIGN_BRIEF_KIOSK_2026.md:39` + L1.1 evidence, V1 kiosk = Electron Windows full-screen. Electron `--kiosk` mode has no URL bar → 100vh = full window height → no problem. NF525 critical: no business-logic breakage either way (cosmetic only). RECOMMENDATION (V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog): if owner ever exposes /kiosk/idle to iPad Safari (e.g. trial mode at trade show), convert 15 sites to `min(100dvh, 100vh)` or pure `100dvh` (graceful Safari ≤15.3 fallback). ~30 LOC across 15 files. NOT a V1 ship blocker. Note: POS V5 already uses `100dvh` at pos-v5.css:29/540/562/944 + PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:979 — pattern exists, just not propagated to kiosk.

edge_cases_audited.name: PWA / apple-mobile-web-app-capable / viewport-fit=cover missing in master.blade.php
edge_cases_audited.verdict: CONFIRMED MISSING — V1 risk only if owner pivots to iPad-standalone
edge_cases_audited.evidence: resources/views/master.blade.php:8 has only `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">`. NO `apple-mobile-web-app-capable=yes`, NO `apple-touch-icon`, NO `theme-color`, NO `viewport-fit=cover`, NO `<link rel="manifest">`. Same gap in resources/views/admin-pos-v4.blade.php:23. Zero PWA manifest file in repo (verified via `find public -name manifest*` returns only `public/js/manifest.js` which is the Laravel Mix asset manifest, NOT a PWA manifest). Consequence: iPad Safari 'Add to Home Screen' for /kiosk/idle would launch in mobile-tab mode (URL bar visible → triggers Q9 issue), not full-screen standalone. iPad Pro 11"/12.9" with notch loses safe-area-inset handling without `viewport-fit=cover` → notch may overlap top content. For V1 Electron Windows kiosk: ZERO impact (no iPad). For future iPad pivot: cluster of fixes needed together (manifest + apple-meta + viewport-fit + safe-area-inset + dvh conversion).
edge_cases_audited.remediation_recommended: Defer to V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog. If owner enables iPad Safari standalone mode: (a) add public/manifest.json with display=fullscreen + start_url=/kiosk/idle + theme_color, (b) add apple-mobile-web-app-capable=yes + apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style=black-translucent + apple-touch-icon, (c) change viewport meta to include viewport-fit=cover, (d) wrap all 100vh in 100dvh per Q9, (e) add env(safe-area-inset-*) padding to KioskAppComponent.vue root.

edge_cases_audited.name: navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() unguarded in NotificationComponent.vue
edge_cases_audited.verdict: CONFIRMED — feature-detect gap in admin notification settings save flow
edge_cases_audited.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/settings/Notification/NotificationComponent.vue:200 calls `navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations()` directly inside the `.then` of the save flow. No `if ('serviceWorker' in navigator)` guard. Failure modes: (a) HTTP context (not localhost) → `navigator.serviceWorker` is undefined → `.getRegistrations()` throws TypeError → admin form save silently breaks (unhandled in .catch). (b) Firefox private mode → ServiceWorker disabled → same TypeError. (c) Safari iOS pre-11.3 → ServiceWorker absent → same TypeError. Used in admin notification settings (FCM provisioning page) which is a one-time admin-only action — low impact frequency. But the error surface = silent JS console error, no user feedback. Pattern is inconsistent with rest of codebase which uses defensive guards (e.g. PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:198-202 wraps `navigator.wakeLock` correctly, useKioskTheme.js:134 wraps `matchMedia` correctly).
edge_cases_audited.remediation_recommended: Replace `navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(...)` with `if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && typeof navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations === 'function') { navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(...).catch(() => {}); }`. ~3 LOC. Frozen-zone-safe (admin Notification settings is not in CLAUDE.md §7).
